decision: Not adopted by the stated bar: every 2G and 5G direction and row total improves, but the 16-flow 0.1%-loss 0.5G medians fall 0.1-0.35% below a narrow control range. A five-repeat follow-up of that point decides.
bar: 0.5G and 2G: no direction below the control range. 5G: no row total, and no row weaker direction (per-repeat minimum of L-R and R-L), below the control range.

conditions.order: for each of three repeats: hash then flows-balanced, each running f4-l0, f16-l0, f4-l1, f16-l1 with fresh daemons
conditions.isolation: daemons and generators on CPUs 0-19; concurrent builds and probe containers used CPUs 20-39 and 60-79
